description: No January 2022 event surfaced in 13 captured open-web query invocations (340 returned result headers). Search silence does not establish that no qualifying protest occurred; without a candidate, threshold, state target, start/end, attendance, organizer, violence and seven response fields cannot be assessed.
required_followup: Coordinator review should compare local-language and contemporary reporting against the unit’s query coverage and retain any newly located event with field-specific evidence. Do not encode protest=0 from this first pass.

description: Queries used Azerbaijani, Russian and English general, weekly, regional and sector terms; they included Baku and regional city names, wage/price, education, workers, farmers, prisoners and opposition themes, plus December 2021 and February 2022 boundaries. This is open-web discovery, not a systematic search of Azerbaijani newspapers or paid archives; local/rural, minority-language and non-indexed sources remain weakly covered.
required_followup: If available, check contemporaneous local newspaper archives, trade and regional outlets, and independent Azerbaijani-language coverage. Keep search URLs and snippets as leads only.

description: A 1 December 2021 Baku protest over Saleh Rustamov’s imprisonment is a boundary lead. No evidence of a January 2022 continuation was found in the captured boundary queries; the RFE/RL and Human Rights House bodies remain unread.
required_followup: Route onset and any continuation evidence to the December 2021 owner. Reopen the episode link only if new January activity is documented.

description: RFE/RL S008 has headline and metadata only. Fresh exact-URL receipt 014 returned stable manual_review with no matching saved denial or written-origin scope; an ordinary GET attempt was rejected by automatic approval before execution. HTTP status is null, so this is an internal approval/review gap, not a site denial. No alternate-route retry was made.
required_followup: Keep S008 body-unread and do not retry through another route. The boundary lead is not essential to a January candidate; continue only if an authorized review resolves the internal restriction.

description: The January railway-publication lead S014 returned HTTP 403 in the web reader. Receipt 019 records an exact-source hold after the card saved the observed response. No PDF body was obtained; no second request was made. The snippet’s protest-related OCR fragments do not identify an event.
required_followup: Treat the URL as blocked and retain the access gap. Do not bypass the 403; seek other independently accessible local labor coverage only if the lead becomes relevant.

description: S006 and S007 show only official education-wage page titles/metadata; S009 shows only a boundary-statement title/metadata. Their bodies were not captured. The two policy pages are context leads only and do not establish a protest.
required_followup: Do not rely on unread bodies for protest facts. Follow up only if another source identifies a gathering or if the body is needed to resolve a specific question under the access protocol.

description: The May 2015 manual copy was available and read, but the current official project baseline and supplementary coding procedure were not verified. The open-web method is not equivalent to LexisNexis or systematic newspaper coverage; the baseline gate remains pending.
